user.title: Energy Planner
user.description: Plans the house battery and EV charging around Amber prices and drives PowerSync.

data.load_includes_ev: House load includes the EV charger
data.grid_power_entity: Grid power (+ import, - export), for charging the car on spare solar
data.solar_power_entity: Solar power now, to correct the forecast
data.ev_soc_entity: Car state of charge (leave empty to estimate it)
data.ev_limit_entity: Charge limit set in the car (caps the EV target)
data.house_hold_entity: Boolean that is on while the EV rule holds the battery
data.price_forecast_entity: Import price forecast entity (only if PowerSync's Amber data is missing)
data.solar_forecast_entities: Solcast forecast entities, comma separated (only if PowerSync's Solcast data is missing)
data.notify_service: Phone alert service when the plan can't be carried out (e.g. notify.mobile_app_poco_x3_gt)

abort.already_configured: Energy Planner is already set up.
